method: Ordinary typography knowledge only. No repository catalog, harness, web search, font metadata, or specimen access was used.
verification_status: All recommendations are provisional. Exact font files, available styles, glyph coverage, and rendered differentiation have not been checked.

suggestions.reason: A restrained interface family with recognizable letterforms and a useful range of weights; a plausible fit for dense operational labels.
suggestions.caveat: Inspect the actual 0/O/1/l glyphs at control size. Do not assume a slashed zero, tabular numerals, or exact Regular/Bold files without checking the chosen build.

suggestions.reason: Its emphasis on distinguishable letterforms makes it a strong candidate where identifiers and counts must be read reliably.
suggestions.caveat: Its proportions may consume more space than a dense UI allows. Verify the supplied Regular/Bold files and 0/O/1/l differentiation in the actual control layout.

briefs.sample: The river remembers. Chapter 04 — Field notes.

suggestions.reason: A reading-oriented serif with a literary tone and an expressive but useful italic.
suggestions.caveat: Verify the actual upright and italic assets, then assess texture, size, and line spacing in a full paragraph; a title-sized sample cannot establish long-reading quality.

suggestions.reason: A balanced serif that can provide warmth without making sustained prose feel ornamental.
suggestions.caveat: Optical-size behavior and available styles depend on the files supplied. Confirm a real italic and compare body text at the intended reading size.

suggestions.reason: A direct geometric, technological voice for a prominent game title.
suggestions.caveat: Orbitron can become difficult to read in small or dense text. Verify title spacing, numerals, and the actual assets for both families; the proposed pairing is not file-verified.

suggestions.reason: A narrow, squared display direction that can suggest a spacecraft interface while using less horizontal space.
suggestions.caveat: Its narrow forms and lighter weights need inspection at the intended sizes. Confirm available files and use a separately tested text face if small mission copy feels fragile.

suggestions.reason: A plausible editorial choice for an archive or museum document, with a family ecosystem known for broad script support.
suggestions.caveat: The family name alone does not prove that a particular subset includes Greek. Check the exact Regular/Bold files for every sample code point and render Greek with fallback disabled.

suggestions.reason: A neutral document alternative that can support clear labels and bilingual information hierarchy.
suggestions.caveat: Confirm that the selected assets include Greek, including the accented ή in Αθήνα, in both required weights. No exact-file or glyph coverage verification has been performed.
